description: Retrieve all judgment receipts associated with a given receipt ID. Judgment receipts are linked via parent_receipt_id. Returns an array of judgment receipt objects ordered by timestamp, including verdict, score, criteria results, and confidence. Use to review the evaluation history of a receipt, compare multiple judgments, or audit AI quality assessments. Returns empty array if no judgments exist.

receipt_id.description: The original receipt ID to get judgments for (not the judgment receipt ID)

name: get_judgments
